coordinateConvention: Same pointy-top axial q,r as expansions/server/gameLogic.js: x ∝ q+r/2, y ∝ r. Per-map origin is arbitrary translation; integer q,r preserve adjacency. Edge side indices 0=upper-right,1=right,2=lower-right,3=lower-left,4=left,5=upper-left. Vertex dir indices 0=top,1=upper-right,2=lower-right,3=bottom,4=lower-left,5=upper-left.
